checked_sources.claim_support: Official page gives March 23, 2003; says it honours films released in 2002; and lists Spirited Away/Hayao Miyazaki as Animated Feature winner with the four listed nominees.
Official record lists The Piano’s three wins: Holly Hunter (Leading Actress), Anna Paquin (Supporting Actress), and Jane Campion (Original Screenplay), plus the relevant nominees.

Official record lists Parasite as Best Picture winner with Kwak Sin Ae and Bong Joon Ho as producers, Bong as Directing winner, its International Feature and Original Screenplay wins, and relevant nominees.
Official record lists Mad Max: Fury Road’s six wins, including Jenny Beavan for Costume Design and Margaret Sixel for Film Editing, and its John Seale cinematography nomination.
Official Academy 2016 film-detail route opened and repeats the Mad Max: Fury Road credit record.
BFI identifies Pather Panchali (1955) as Satyajit Ray’s debut and the first entry in the Apu Trilogy, and credits Ray as director.
BFI identifies Aparajito (1956) and The World of Apu (1959) as the two further Apu films; the cited source uses the English title, not ‘Apur Sansar’.
BFI credits Carol Reed as director, Graham Greene as writer, and describes Robert Krasker’s photography and Anton Karas’s zither score.
BFI says The Third Man was largely shot on location in Vienna in 1948 and calls Krasker Reed’s cinematographer.
